value.rationale: An exceptional-characteristic degeneration of a canonical, historically distinguished plane equation separates its singular naive reduction (a wild unibranch genus-zero quartic) from the smooth genus-three potentially good model. Determining the exact cusp characteristic, geometric genus, and all-extension point counts is a natural boundary result in arithmetic reduction theory, not merely a coordinate rephrasing.
